correctness.rationale: For exactly the true-diagonal query universe, the all-positive pattern forces the support to be a noncrossing forest. For every positive subset A of a noncrossing forest S, the boundary cycle plus A is connected and planar and has a spanning tree containing A and no negative query diagonal, proving every binary trace. Noncrossing diagonal forests are exactly polygon dissections in which every face touches an original boundary side: all-diagonal faces form cycles and an interior cycle encloses a face without boundary. Decomposing by a root side yields the two formal equations with a unique x-adically determined solution. Maximal supports are the dual-path triangulations, counted by the valid ear insertion recurrence. Reproducible verify.py checks forest histograms and generating function n=3..12, actual noncrossing-tree traces on all 549 diagonal supports n=3..6, and the top coefficient. The all-order argument is independent of these finite experiments.

originality.rationale: The full diagonal-only Boolean shattering criterion and coupled algebraic all-coefficient enumerator were not implied by the closest inspected unrestricted forest enumeration, geometric reconfiguration, blockers, heptagon all-edge Fourier, or finite half-turn fixed-locus results. Hurtado–Noy 1996 ALREADY determines the numerical \(n2^{n-5}\) two-ear triangulation count; novelty is NOT claimed for this count in isolation, only its interpretation within the new complete shattering theorem. Inaccessible or unindexed equivalents remain an explicit priority risk.
residual_risks: A prior result about polygon dissections with every face incident to a boundary side might encode the same algebraic series under different terminology.

A general weighted noncrossing-forest enumeration that distinguishes boundary edges could imply the complete diagonal-only coefficients; no such dominating statement was identified in the inspected texts.
The top-degree coefficient is covered by Hurtado–Noy two-ear enumeration and must not be interpreted as an independently new count.
Scientific novelty remains a best-knowledge historical assessment, not a proof of uniqueness.

value.rationale: Genuine polygon diagonals are natural observable queries while polygon sides serve as internal witness edges. The theorem gives a complete exact support criterion with an elementary polynomial-time test, a new all-parameter algebraic face-count series (all coefficients, not just a dimension), and an exact characterization of the top-dimensional supports. The result is substantive even after crediting the already-known two-ear triangulation count.
